title: Settings menu missing in iOS app (1.88.1)
body: The latest version of the iOS app is missing the settings menu in the top right, and it is impossible to set a custom coordination server.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/efee78c1-7779-48f1-8e0d-e37ca65a866a)

Previous version 1.86.4 is fine

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
1. Same issue on iOS 26.0rc1 and iPadOS 26.0rc1.  Can't even get to the screen to submit a bug report. 

2. I have two logins to the same Tailnet, one with admin access, the other with restricted access via ACLs.  I can't toggle between the two accounts like previous versions. Perhaps related to 1.

3. It appears some connect on demand setting are not working.  Example 1: I set do nothing while on cellular, but it still connects.  I can't confirm CoD settings are still setup because of problem 1.    Example 2: I also set do not connect when on my home WiFi.  I happened to notice the iOS Settings->VPN->VPN Status button is greyed out when on local WiFi, which seems to align with my CoD settings. Not sure if this was intentional behavior.  I also have do not connect set for my '25 Bronco Sport CarPlay Wifi, which does not grey out the iOS Settings->VPN->VPN Status button. So at a minimum there seems to be some inconsistency in the button behavior.  I think iOS treats CarPlay WiFi differently than WiFi access points, i.e. it treats CarPlay as a P2P connection and does not actually route data though the connection.  It actually routes data over the cellular modem.  

4. On iPadOS 26.0rc1 even though it shows Tailscale VPN is connected, it never brings up the list of nodes.

comments.body: I’m experiencing a similar but slightly different bug. **Environment** - iPhone 16 (iOS 18.6.2) - iPad 6th gen (iPadOS 17.7.10) - Tailscale v1.88.1 **Observed behavior** - When disconnected from the tailnet, everything works as expected. - When connected to the tailnet, the device list does not appear, although the tailnet itself works fine. - If I keep the VPN connected, swipe up to close the Tailscale app, and then relaunch it, the device list temporarily appears. **Additional information** - Tried logging out/in and reinstalling the app, but the issue persists. - This problem did not occur with v1.86.4.
